full_page.content:
c. 1939
The following is a faithful transcription of Autograph written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F.M. Cap. in a book of the "Mystical City of God".
A. Wonderful Work in the following pages ...... !
So wonderful is this abreviated history that it deserves to be prayed rather than simply read.
Fr. Solanus, O.M.C.
(He added the following later)
God bless you and yours. He will surely bless you as often as with becoming reverence you read from the follow- ing pages. Why? Because this Book treats of God's own Blessed Mother Mary - our Heavenly Mother. And there is no one else on earth or in Heaven that God Himself loves as He loves the same His Ever Virgin Immaculate Mother - and wishes Her to be known and loved. Queen of the Universe.
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
Book in possession of. Mrs. Donald (01ga) Cunec 12601 Wilshire Detroit, Michigan 48213
